title: Template successor labels
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a finite binary Turing machine $M$, define the successor label of a template: the prefix template maps to $rZ$, a zero-generating template maps to $zInc$, the dummy template maps to $lay(true)$, and the final template maps to the stop label. Every other template maps to its phase-$0$ input label.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite binary Turing machine
